Tamil Nadu to launch gold ring scheme for newborns

Tamil Nadu is set to launch a scheme providing a one-gram gold ring to newborn babies. The initiative is scheduled to begin on September 28. The first batch will include 1.28 lakh rings. The scheme was announced by Chief Minister M.K. Stalin.
